newsitem.title: UK: UK's Brown wants stable and competitive pound.
newsitem.headline: UK's Brown wants stable and competitive pound.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said he wanted a stable and competitive pound.
"We want a stable and competitive pound over the medium term, consistent with our objective of price stability," he told a news conference.
"I am convinced that it is in the interests of industry that our commitment to low inflation is delivered in practice." The case for a quarter-point rate rise was therefore conclusive.
British industrialists have been complaining that the strength of sterling has made it more dificult for them to export their goods.
